item.title: Running Llama.cpp on AMD Strix Halo
item.description: Getting llama.cpp running on the AMD Radeon 8060S with ROCm, gfx1151, and unified memory on Ubuntu 26.04 — covering BIOS and TTM memory configuration, custom gfx1151 compilation, and benchmarks across 7B, 27B, 30B, 72B, and GPT-OSS 120B.

item.title: Owning Your Private AI Assistant
item.description: Explore how Local AI Starter brings private, browser-based AI to life with WebGPU, LiteRT-LM, local model caching, persistent memory, voice agents, PWA support, and optional neural TTS — all without a traditional AI backend.
